description: Environment + DEMO seed: the idempotent DEMO fees seed (fees module ENTITLED+ACTIVE, an ACCOUNTANT user + membership + ACCOUNTANT role, one ACTIVE FeeStructure + one TUITION FeeComponent, one posted StudentCharge on the seeded student, NO real payment rows) and the Razorpay .env.example placeholders + the owner-role PRIVILEGED_DATABASE_URL/DIRECT_URL note. Depends on FEAT-001 (schema, ACCOUNTANT role seed, fee tables) and benefits from FEAT-002 (the ACCOUNTANT role must exist from the migration seed). Grounded in design §D.6/§D.8 (env) and §D.14 (seed). Leaves the repo buildable: the seed runs idempotently; no secret is committed. Independent of FEAT-004 (tests), but ordered before it so the behavioral suite can rely on the demo fixtures if it chooses.
steps: Read context.json and design §D.14 FIRST, plus packages/db/src/seed.ts to match its patterns (TEMPLATE_ROLE_NAMES, ensureMembership, institutionModule.upsert for library, studentProfile.findUnique({ where: { enrollmentNo: 'BCA2024001' } })).

Edit packages/db/src/seed.ts: add TEMPLATE_ROLE_NAMES['ACCOUNTANT'] = 'Accountant' (so seedRbacCatalogue names it). Upsert the fees InstitutionModule ENTITLED+ACTIVE for the DEMO institution (on institutionId_moduleKey, moduleKey 'fees', state 'ACTIVE', entitledAt/activatedAt now), mirroring the library module upsert block.

Create an ACCOUNTANT demo user (e.g. accountant@demo.edu / accountant123, legacy role GUARD inert like the librarian/officer precedent, accountStatus ACTIVE, institutionId demo) via prisma.user.upsert on email, then ensureMembership(user.id, institutionId, 'ACCOUNTANT', roleIdByKey). Idempotent.

Create one ACTIVE FeeStructure (name e.g. 'BCA 2026-2027 Fees', demo institution, optional programId = seeded BCA program, status ACTIVE) and one FeeComponent (category TUITION, amountPaise 5000000n, currency 'INR') under it, using find-first-then-create or an upsert keyed on a business unique (e.g. (institutionId, name)) so re-runs do not duplicate.

Post one StudentCharge to the seeded BCA2024001 student (demoStudent = prisma.studentProfile.findUnique({ where: { enrollmentNo: 'BCA2024001' } }); skip if absent): snapshot amountPaise 5000000n, category TUITION, description e.g. 'Tuition 2026-2027', status PENDING, postedByUserId = the accountant user id. Idempotent via a find-first guard on (institutionId, studentId, feeComponentId). Insert NO PaymentTransaction/PaymentAllocation/Receipt rows.
Add a seed console.log line for the fees fixtures (module + accountant + structure + one posted charge), matching the existing demo-credentials summary block.

Edit apps/api/.env.example: add RAZORPAY_KEY_ID (TEST vs LIVE; the only value ever sent to a client), RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET (never leaves the server), RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET (never leaves the server) as PLACEHOLDERS, plus a comment that amounts are INR paise, real keys are never committed and .env is never staged, and that PRIVILEGED_DATABASE_URL (or DIRECT_URL) MUST point at the Postgres owner role (never campass_app) because the webhook's pre-tenant order lookup needs a true RLS-bypassing connection (§D.8).
acceptance_criteria: `npx tsx packages/db/src/seed.ts` completes without error and is idempotent: a second run produces the same single ACCOUNTANT user, one FeeStructure, one FeeComponent, and one posted StudentCharge, with NO payment/allocation/receipt rows and no duplicates.
The DEMO institution has the fees InstitutionModule in state ACTIVE after seeding.
apps/api/.env.example contains the three RAZORPAY_* placeholders and the owner-role PRIVILEGED_DATABASE_URL/DIRECT_URL note; no real secret value is present and no .env is staged.
verification: npx tsx packages/db/src/seed.ts (run twice) — second run idempotent, no duplicates, exit 0
grep apps/api/.env.example for RAZORPAY_KEY_ID, RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET, RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET and the owner-role note
query (via the seed output logs) that the demo fees module is ACTIVE and exactly one charge is posted to BCA2024001
findings: Done. (1) packages/db/src/seed.ts: added TEMPLATE_ROLE_NAMES['ACCOUNTANT'] = 'Accountant'; added an idempotent fees block after the admissions block — upsert the fees InstitutionModule ENTITLED+ACTIVE for the DEMO institution (on institutionId_moduleKey, state 'ACTIVE', entitledAt/activatedAt now, mirroring the library/admissions upserts); accountant@demo.edu / accountant123 user (legacy role GUARD inert, accountStatus ACTIVE, demo institution) via user.upsert on email + ensureMembership(..., 'ACCOUNTANT', roleIdByKey); one ACTIVE FeeStructure 'BCA 2026-2027 Fees' (programId=BCA, academicSessionId=2026-2027) via upsert on (institutionId,name); one TUITION FeeComponent amountPaise 5000000n currency INR via findFirst-then-create on (institutionId,feeStructureId,category); one PENDING StudentCharge (5000000n, TUITION, description 'Tuition 2026-2027', postedByUserId=accountant) on the seeded BCA2024001 StudentProfile via findFirst guard on (institutionId,studentId,feeComponentId); NO PaymentTransaction/PaymentAllocation/Receipt rows. Added accountant credentials to the login summary block and a fees-fixture console.log line. (2) apps/api/.env.example: added a Razorpay section with RAZORPAY_KEY_ID (TEST vs LIVE, only value sent to client), RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET, RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET placeholders, a note that amounts are INR paise and real keys are never committed / .env never staged, and the owner-role PRIVILEGED_DATABASE_URL/DIRECT_URL (vs campass_app) requirement for the webhook pre-tenant lookup (§D.8). No .env or real secret staged. Prisma client already had the fees models generated (FEAT-001). VERIFICATION: ran `npx tsx src/seed.ts` from packages/db (how db:seed loads the .env) twice — both exit 0, identical output; a DB count query confirmed fees module state ACTIVE, exactly 1 accountant user / 1 FeeStructure / 1 FeeComponent / 1 StudentCharge and 0 payment_transactions / 0 payment_allocations / 0 receipts (idempotent, no duplicates). grep of apps/api/.env.example confirmed the three RAZORPAY_* placeholders + the owner-role note. No transient Supabase P1001 encountered.
